newsitem.title: USA: America Online cools to CompuServe bid-Post.
newsitem.headline: America Online cools to CompuServe bid-Post.

text.p: America Online Inc.'s interest in buying rival CompuServe Corp. outright has waned, the Washington Post said in Friday editions, quoting industry sources.
But it said buying pieces of CompuServe may still hold some appeal for America Online.
No discussions to buy the entire company were taking place as of last week, one investment analyst told the newspaper. No deal appeared imminent yesterday, it quoted another source as saying.
AOL had been studying a possible stock purchase of CompuServe from parent H&R Block Inc. to help penetrate the business-to-business and overseas markets, where CompuServe is relatively strong.
